why: All three checks positively confirm the finding; I could not refute it. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM. curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/typescript.md (4822 lines, md5 f914f5c605c85f827fa2a906a931e4ea) carries the claimed string at line 1559. od -c on the whole line gives exactly '  | "DirectoryAdded"\n' - two leading spaces, pipe, space, quoted name, newline; byte-identical to the claim, no second sentence hiding on the line. It sits inside the 'type HookEvent =' union under '### HookEvent' ('Available hook events.'), lines 1534-1565, which enumerates 31 members. The same page specifies the behaviour in full at lines 1980-1988: 'type DirectoryAddedHookInput = BaseHookInput & { hook_event_name: "DirectoryAdded"; directory: string; source: "slash_command" | "register_repo_root"; }' followed by the prose 'source is "slash_command" when /add-dir added it and "register_repo_root" when the SDK control request did' - so the CLAIMED BEHAVIOUR is the page's own words, not an inference. The page is row 52 of scripts/claude-doc-pages.tsv ('agent-sdk/typescript'), i.e. a checked Claude contract source under AGENTS.md, not an out-of-scope platform.claude.com page. (2) REPO STATE CONFIRMED AT THE CITED LINES. packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters.ts:123-152 is CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP with exactly 28 entries (Setup..SessionEnd) and no DirectoryAdded; :99-102 is DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS with exactly two keys, MessageDisplay and TeammateIdle; :117-122 is the doc comment reading '28 of the 30 documented Claude hook events', which is stale against this page's 31. Absence verified NUL-safe: grep -ra "DirectoryAdded" packages apps scripts --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.json --include=*.js --include=*.cjs -> 0 hits. packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts PluginHookEventName lists 30 names (the 28 Claude ones plus McpServerStart/McpToolCall) and likewise omits it. (3) CONSEQUENCE VERIFIED SEPARATELY FROM THE IDENTIFIER - nothing upstream or downstream absorbs it. mapExternalHookEventName (format-adapters.ts:622-646) resolves in strict order dialect table -> DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS -> pluginDiagnostic('warning','plugin.format.unknown_hook_event'); there is no generic fallback arm. The Claude adapter is the only caller for this dialect (format-adapters/claude.ts:1308) and at :1310-1319 it pushes mapped.diagnostics and then falls back to reasonCode 'plugin.deferred.claude_hook_event_unsupported' because mapped.deferredReasonCode is undefined. So a Claude plugin declaring a DirectoryAdded hook is imported with the generic unknown-event warning plus a generic (not routed) deferral - exactly the outcome the code's own comment at :634-635 and :1312-1314 says it wants to avoid ('A documented-but-unemitted event is a deferral, not an unknown name'). No sibling-subsystem mixup: CwdChanged is a distinct SDK event we DO map (format-adapters.ts:143), and Codex's CODEX_HOOK_EVENT_MAP is a separate table that also omits it. NOT AN OWNER DECISION: I read all nine dated decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3. Item 5 is the only hook-related one and it scopes 'do not revive' to the dead executor in hooks-runtime.ts (PluginHookRuntime/runHooks/parseHookOutput/createHookRegistryFromProjection) while explicitly PRESERVING PluginHookEventName because three production files import it - it says nothing about the event roster. None of the other eight touch hooks. NOT A DELIBERATE PRODUCT DIFFERENCE either: this is neither a subscription flow, nor gateway routing, nor de-branding, and the underlying surface exists in our fork (session-scoped addDirectories grants at pi-agent.ts:883-885, :3193). CAVEATS, none fatal: (a) the claim's own grep command included --include=*.md and asserted 0 hits, but four docs/superpowers/specs/*.md files DO mention DirectoryAdded - they are this sweep's own output, self-referential, so the code-level absence still holds; (b) the hook is not silently dropped entirely - it still produces a deferred report entry, just with the generic reason code rather than a routed one, which is what the claim actually says. DUPLICATE: this is the same single gap as f000 (agent-sdk/hooks, already challenged and survived) and f129 (changelog); three Claude pages document DirectoryAdded, so it should be fixed once, not three times.
correctedState: Confirmed as stated, with two precisions. DirectoryAdded is absent from all repo code (grep -ra over packages/apps/scripts for *.ts,*.tsx,*.json,*.js,*.cjs -> 0 hits); it only appears in this sweep's own docs/superpowers/specs/*.md files, so the claim's '*.md -> 0 hits' is inaccurate but immaterial. It is missing from CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP (format-adapters.ts:123-152, 28 entries), from DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS (:99-102, only MessageDisplay and TeammateIdle) and from PluginHookEventName (hooks-runtime.ts, 30 names). The runtime consequence is that a Claude plugin declaring a DirectoryAdded hook gets BOTH a generic 'plugin.format.unknown_hook_event' warning (format-adapters.ts:638-644) AND a generic deferral entry 'plugin.deferred.claude_hook_event_unsupported' (format-adapters/claude.ts:1315) - i.e. it is reported as a typo rather than as a routed, reasoned deferral; it is not silently dropped. The doc comment at :117-122 ('28 of the 30 documented Claude hook events') is stale: agent-sdk/typescript.md's HookEvent union now lists 31. Same gap as f000 and f129 - one fix, three citations.
